subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Welcome – Lesson 2: Back to school, alphabet and spelling names
outcomes: I can name the characters in the story Back to school.
I can say the alphabet in order.
I can ask for and spell a name letter by letter.

tf.why: Yes! Polly is the parrot in the story.
Atomic is the cat in the story.

tf.s: The letter H comes after G.
The letter M comes before L.
tf.why: L comes first: K, L, M.

tf.s: We ask How do you spell your name? to hear the letters.
tf.why: We spell a name letter by letter.

tf.s: Jack is the boy with the red cap and glasses.
Fatma has got twelve colouring pencils.
tf.why: Fatma has got fourteen colouring pencils.

tf.s: The last letter of the alphabet is Y.
In alphabet order, Sami comes before Fatma.
tf.why: F comes before S, so Fatma comes first.

boxes.q: What is the name of the cat?
boxes.why: Atomic is the cat in the story.
J, K, L: L comes after K.

boxes.q: Listen: P-o-l-l-y. Which name is it?
boxes.why: P, o, l, l, y spells Polly.

boxes.q: Which is the first letter of the alphabet?

boxes.why: K, i, t, e spells kite.

boxes.q: Which letters are missing? J K _ M N O _ Q
boxes.why: J K L M N O P Q.

boxes.q: How many colouring pencils has Fatma got?

boxes.why: F, a, t, m, a spells Fatma.

hunt.q: The boy with the red cap

mcq.q: Which question do we use to ask about a name?

mcq.why: Polly is a parrot and Atomic is a cat.

mcq.q: Which is the right way to spell pen?
Your friend asks How do you spell Sami? What do you say?
mcq.why: We spell it letter by letter.

mcq.q: Which letters are missing? C _ E F _ H
mcq.why: C D E F G H.

mcq.q: Listen: L-i-l-y. Which name is it?
mcq.why: L, i, l, y spells Lily.

mcq.q: Put the names in alphabet order: Sami, Atomic, Lily, Fatma
mcq.why: A, F, L, S is alphabet order.

mcq.q: Which name comes first in alphabet order?
mcq.why: J comes before L, P and S.

mcq.q: A word is spelled h-a-t. How many letters has it got?
